objective.name: sandbox.inspect.inputs
objective.description: Return exactly the params visible by a wrapper capacity, including injected @matter refs.

#root.role: Expose the effective params and matter refs observed by the wrapper runtime.

transformation_contract.morphing: Wrapper inputs become an explicit reflection of the params and matter refs observed by the wrapper runtime.
invariants: The capability reflects params exactly as observed by the wrapper runtime after Execution-side injection.
Incoming @matter bindings are visible to the wrapper as part of received_params when present.
The capability does not resolve matter contents; it only reflects the received envelope.
success: On success, sandbox.inspect.inputs returns received_params together with ctx_id and wrapper_name.
This makes the wrapper-visible contract surface directly assertable from tests.
failure: sandbox.inspect.inputs has no contract-level validation failure for missing label or @matter entries because it is purely observational.
The capability only fails if the underlying wrapper runtime cannot execute.
notes: This capability is an introspection oracle for wrapper input plumbing in N7.
Use sandbox.inspect.resolved.inputs when resolved matter content is needed in addition to the raw envelope.
The returned ctx_id and wrapper_name make it possible to verify which wrapper instance observed the injected envelope.
